author: blekek.k
title: Illustrators wanted for trading card project
content: Hi warga threads! We're looking for illustrators for our little trading card project. Whether you draw professionally, as a hobby, are still a student, or already work full-time, feel free to reach out. We're looking for artists that draws: Anime / manga style illustrations; Cartoon / semi-cartoon illustration; Pokemon / One Piece / MTG TCG artwork; Semi-realistic illustrations; and any other art styles. Comment if you're interested or DM me directly! Follow-up (09/22/26): Thanks you guys for reaching out. I'm surprised by the amount of people who are interested. I'll be checking your portfolio. For the ones who haven't sent in their portfolio, you can provide a link where I can see your previous works. Contact: comment on the post or DM @blekek.k.

author: Veli Raiya
title: Fantasy map designer and character illustrator wanted
content: Looking for a fantasy book map designer + character illustrator! Definitely does not have to be the same artist for both. Bonus points if you are a fantasy author recommending someone you have personally worked with. See the next posts for more details. Character art: gravitates toward realistic, epic fantasy concept art rather than cartoon; book is lighter fantasy but wants grounded, lifelike art; open to different styles; bonus for POC and a wide variety of ethnicities. Needs portraits for now, and more if the style fits the series. Map: detailed and immersive classic fantasy-map feel, stylistically open. Contact: reply on the thread with work/recs or DM @veliraiyawrites.
